purpose: Sourced undergraduate programme/route facts for public exploratory survey; not personal admission advice or probability.
referenceCode: src/lib/admissions/catalog.js (read only); fields preserve current OPTIONS names plus evidence and native policies.

evidenceContract.sourceResolution: Every sourceKey/sourceKeys/source refers to sources[key], carrying exact URL, scope and checkedAt. Programme evidence groups bind shared provenance to identity, field, language, route, duration, intake, tuition and requirements. Native policies retain field-level applicability.
evidenceContract.unknowns: Null/missing/not_checked/partial/inferred are not verified passes. Missing attributes not explicitly collected remain unknown.
evidenceContract.policyResolution: requirementPolicyId resolves in requirementPolicies; policies are part of the contract, not optional notes.
evidenceContract.dates: Checked date is retrieval date; feeYear and intakeYear are independent. No automatic year rollover.
evidenceContract.projection: This is not a drop-in OPTIONS replacement. Integration must preserve native credential routes and scope. Current normalized rule grammar supports grade/ielts/all/any/unknown only; other tests, subjects and point systems remain explicit unevaluated requirements.
evidenceContract.normalizedRules: languageThreshold applies to degree stage; languageRequirement deliberately incomplete. A known lower IELTS must produce unmet/clarification, even if other fields unknown. Known above-minimum overall without section/date/type proof is not full compliance.
evidenceContract.costs: Annual, semester and tuition+fees estimates are distinct. comparisonVerified=false until adapter confirms matching currency/period/year/stage and personalised scope; do not silently divide or convert, choose cheapest load, or subtract possible scholarships.
evidenceContract.language: For UK and Iowa, English medium is an explicitly labelled inference from official English-course/admission context; explicit programme medium statement not collected. Else provenance scope says programme or university level.
evidenceContract.taxonomy: Fields are survey routing suggestions, not a world classification. Debrecen mapping to computer_engineering is explicitly inferred from its engineering curriculum; keep exact degree name.
evidenceContract.credentialScopeKeys: Normalized credential strings in rule.scope use the credential IDs in requirementPolicies (e.g. professional_college_diploma). Adapter must map user credential explicitly; never treat a missing or different credential as met.

discoveryPolicy.countMeaning: Different universities after filters, never several degrees of one university counted as separate choices.

highlySelective.ifVerifiedHighlySelective: exclude_from_general_fallback_for_weak_or_incomplete_profile; only separate aspiration context if explicitly requested
highlySelective.unknownSelectivity: not easy, standard or guaranteed; exploration with warning, no fabricated probability

discoveryPolicy.knownInputs: Evaluate all known academic/language inputs in their real scales and applicability. Missing credential/scale does not erase an observed shortfall or become a pass. Preserve alternatives: grade shortfall is not final rejection where a verified SAT/ACT alternative remains possible.
discoveryPolicy.knownUnmet: Do not present as suitable/top3. If retained for learning, separate as needs_preparation_or_clarification with precise shortfall and source.
discoveryPolicy.foundation: Separate route/section requiring explicit interest; unknown preference never grants direct eligibility or hides preparation time/fee. Degree tuition and IELTS must not be copied onto foundation.
discoveryPolicy.incompleteProfile: Only relevant programme discovery with explicit unknowns; exclude proven credential contradictions for the selected direct route. No institutional-brand-first default.
discoveryPolicy.top3Meaning: Explain preference/evidence order among eligible exploration candidates; no admission likelihood, no forced three when coverage insufficient.
